title: Concept: Missing X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies response header
description: No X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies header was sent. A legacy client falls back to its own default and the site cannot state that cross-domain policy files are disallowed, so a forgotten crossdomain.xml stays effective for that client class.
risk: Legacy cross-domain policy reachable; LOW severity because modern browsers no longer use it.
